item.title: Las Vegas Raider gifts U.S. Army vet, Purple Heart recipient trip to Super Bowl
item.description: Las Vegas Raider, Ashton Jeanty, teamed up with USAA, the Official Salute to Service Partner, and Disabled American Veterans to gift a U.S. Army veteran and Purple Heart recipient a surprise trip to the Super Bowl.

item.title: NIL's impact on high school students, recruitment
item.description: Hoop dreams are becoming just that for more and more young athletes -- a dream. The storybook journey from backyard courts to varsity, then the big time college and off to the league is becoming less attainable, says Devin Matthews.

item.title: Court records show settlement between 'Trey Songz,' man who alleged singer beat him at Las Vegas Strip hotel
item.description: Court records indicate a settlement between singer Tremaine Neverson, also known as "Trey Songz," and a man who alleged Neverson and his security team beat him at a Las Vegas Strip hotel.

item.title: Video shows inside of suspected Las Vegas bio lab raid; here's what we know
item.description: New video from police shows the inside of a Las Vegas home containing a suspected biological laboratory raided by Metro police and the FBI over the weekend.

item.title: Single-vehicle crash closes central Las Vegas valley intersection
item.description: A single vehicle crash closed a central Las Vegas valley intersection Monday evening, according to Metro police.

item.title: Multi-vehicle crash closes southbound I-15 near Nevada-California border
item.description: A crash closed all southbound lanes on Interstate 15 near the Nevada-California border Monday evening, according to RTC of Southern Nevada.

item.title: Clark County School District volunteers talk absenteeism with parents
item.description: Sitting on the Las Vegas apartment stoop, several students from Vail Pittman Elementary listened as school leaders worked to convince their parents to send them to school. “I’m trying my best,” one parent confessed.

item.title: Charges filed against Las Vegas bio lab suspect in federal court: 'Any guns left?'
